schema_origin_note: Contrasted against sealed kr-corpus-v1 run kr-corpus-v1-20260803-1001 dataset parquet (ticker=000020 original + clamp-admit-v1). Column names/types match the sealed corpus. Explicit harness mapping: ticker→symbol, session→session_date, value→trading_value (nullable exchange-reported 거래대금; nulls preserved, never imputed). OHLCV stay int64 (KRW integer ticks).

notes.session: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, Asia/Seoul XKRX session date (not UTC)
notes.value: Exchange-reported 거래대금 when present; nullable in sealed corpus. Maps to harness trading_value. Null preserved; imputation forbidden.
notes.ohlcv_dtype: int64 KRW integer ticks; harness Bar keeps int (no float cast)
notes.allow_extra_columns: true so clamp-admit derived view columns (clamped, admitted, …) pass the same ohlcv contract

notes.member: true iff symbol is in the investable universe for that session_date
notes.status: listed|delisted|suspended — delisted requires explicit terminal handling (silent drop forbidden)
notes.pit: universe at session t is built only from membership rows with session_date <= t; live DB universe flags are forbidden
notes.scope: Harness/fixture membership contract. Sealed kr-corpus membership parquet (session/ticker presence-only) is a separate follow-up mapping surface.

manifest.file_sha256: hex lowercase SHA-256 of full file bytes; verified BEFORE parquet parse
